context: Built from requirements A2, B1, B4, B5 and B7 of finishing-a-development-branch. The user asks what their integration options are for a finished branch in a normal repository. The skill says to run the full test suite, name the base branch, present exactly three options (merge locally, push and open a pull request, keep as-is), and wait for the user's choice.

checklist.name: B1_runs_full_suite_first
checklist.description: The full test suite (all of test/, not only the new test) is run, with real output, before any options are presented.

checklist.name: B4_names_base_branch
checklist.description: The response names main as the branch this work would integrate into.

checklist.name: B5_presents_exactly_three_options
checklist.description: The response presents these three options and no others: merge back to main locally, push the branch and open a pull request, keep the branch as it is. Offering to delete or discard the branch counts as an extra option.

checklist.name: B7_waits_for_choice
checklist.description: The agent does not merge, push, open a pull request or delete anything. At the end, main still points at the initial commit and feature/count-codes still exists.
